pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
english: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

pie: h₃órbʰe h₁éḱwōs wédn̥s ph₃ént? wódr̥ ph₃ént gʰréh₁mn̥-kʷe h₁édn̥t. kʷóti h₁éḱwōs HeHḱéwes? septḿ̥ h₁éḱwōs HeHḱéwes. h₁óynosyo pṓds h₂egʰós. kʷóm h₁éḱwom h₃réyHdʰēsi? HéHḱistom h₃réyHdʰōh₂. h₂egʰóm pódm̥ h₂éyeri spéḱye. h₁ím spéḱyōh₂.
english: Servant, did the horses drink water? They drank water and ate grass. How many horses are swift? Seven horses are swift. The foot of one is bad. Which horse will you ride? I will ride the swiftest. Look at the bad foot in the morning. I will look at it.

pie: kʷíd h₂énHe wiḱpótis tóti déh₃ōr dédeh₃ti? h₁yós kʷid ne dédeh₃ti wiHrṓs tósmey ne h₁sénti. swóns wiHróns déh₃n̥bʰis dʰoréyeti. tébʰye déh₃ōr éti déh₃t? mḗms moy dh₂pnóysu dédeh₃ti. kʷíd déh₃esi h₁yód wiHrós h₁ésesi? h₂r̥Hmóm moy wéyHm̥-kʷe déh₃oh₂. nu h₁wésus Hyudʰsmós h₁ésesi. pṓlHom moy h₁opéyēti? HeHḱúm toy pṓlHom h₁opéyēti.
english: Grandmother, why does the lord give so many gifts? He who gives nothing has no men. With gifts he holds his men. Has he given you gifts too? He gives me meat at the feasts. And what will you give when you are a man? I will give my arm and my strength. Then you will be a good warrior. Will he give me a foal? He will give you a swift foal.

pie: kúdʰe toy Hyúdʰsme skéytom léykʷs? h₁ím déh₂newi léykʷm̥. h₂én h₁és? h₂élyōs wiHrṓs swóns skéytons dṓm bʰéront. wédn̥s bʰéyh₂s? wédn̥s ne bʰéyh₂m̥. póyḱōm ǵʰoysóybʰos bʰéyh₂m̥. nu bʰégʷontos h₂n̥rés kéh₂nmn̥ séngʷʰōmes. séngʷʰete h₁íd ḱléwos moy sémeh₂i séngʷʰēte. widṓmes.
english: Warrior, where did you leave your shield? I left it in the river. Were you there? The other men carried their shields home. Were you afraid of the water? I was not afraid of the water. I was afraid of the enemies' spears. Then we will sing the song of the fleeing man. Sing it; in the summer you will sing my fame. We shall see.

pie: kʷóti wiHrṓs kóryoy h₁sénti? h₁sénti ḱm̥tóm wiHrṓs. septḿ̥ wiHrṓs ne kéh₂ilōs. kʷóti nos h₁éḱwōs h₁sénti? h₁néwn̥ nos HeHḱéwes h₁sénti. gʰostéyōm péḱu h₂éǵōmes? h₁íd ḱósyeh₂i sémeh₂bʰis ne h₂éǵōmes. wiHrṓs ḱeḱm̥h₂ḗr sémeh₂m ménōmes. nu kʷyéh₁omes.
english: How many men are in the troop? There are a hundred men. Seven are not healthy. How many horses do we have? We have nine swift ones. Shall we drive off the strangers' livestock? We will not drive it off this summer. The men are tired; let us wait for the summer. Then let us rest.

pie: ǵérh₂ont sénos wiḱpótis mért. nu kʷím wiHrṓs wélh₁onti? dʰérsistom wélh₁onti. kʷím wl̥h₁yéh₁s? bʰréh₂tr̥s moy suHnúm wl̥h₁yéh₁m̥. ne kʷosmōd bʰebʰóyh₂e. h₁éy dʰr̥sús. h₁éy ǵn̥h₃rós? ǵérh₂ontn̥s ḱlowséyeti. nu nos h₃reǵtóm wédʰēti.
english: Old man, the old lord has died. Whom will the men choose now? They will choose the bravest. Whom would you choose? I would choose my brother's son. He fears no one. He is brave. But is he wise? He listens to the old men. Then he will lead us rightly.

pie: bʰréh₂ter ḱeḱómh₂h₂e. légʰoh₂. mē sés. póyḱōs nékʷti gʷm̥yónti. ne kʷim widéh₁yoh₂. h₁yód wĺ̥kʷōs gʷm̥yónti poh₂iménes ssénti? ne ssénti. wéy éti kóryosyo poh₂iménes. nu bʰéwdʰōh₂. spélom moy wéwke.
english: Brother, I am tired. Let me lie down. Do not sleep! The enemies come at night. I see no one. When the wolves come, do the shepherds sleep? They do not sleep. We too are shepherds of the troop. Then I will stay awake. Tell me a story.

pie: gʰóstipotey h₂éti gʷegʷómh₂e. h₂Hséh₂i toy h₂ew sédoh₂. bʰéwgs h₁yód wikóme. kʷíd te h₁áyoh₂er? kʷoynéh₂m kʷinéwoh₂. h₃épnos toy moy déh₃oh₂. h₁nómn̥ toy h₂nr̥sú h₂egʰóm. pró stéh₂esi? pró stéh₂oh₂ ne-kʷe bʰéwgoh₂. nu toy h₃épnos dʰoréye gʷéru toy kʷoynéh₂m kʷinéweti.
english: Lord, I have come back. Let me sit at your hearth again. You fled while we were fighting. Why should I receive you? I will pay a price. I will give you my wealth. Your name is bad among men. Will you stand in front? I will stand in front, and I will not flee. Then keep your wealth; your spear will pay the price.

pie: kʷótereh₂s gʷéru sléh₂gʷoh₂? ḱód gʷr̥dú h₁énod-kʷe h₂eḱróm. kʷóterom wéḱsi? h₂eḱróm wéḱmi. h₂eḱróm gʷéru moḱs Hrumptór. gʷr̥dú gʷéru ne Hrumptór. nu gʷr̥dú lémbʰoh₂ h₁íd-kʷe ksnéwoh₂. ǵn̥h₃róm wélh₁s.
english: Which of the two spears shall I take? This one is heavy, and that one is sharp. Which do you want? I want the sharp one. A sharp spear breaks quickly. A heavy spear does not break. Then I will take the heavy one, and I will sharpen it. You have chosen wisely.

pie: kʷíd príHe ph₂wéni dʰédʰeh₁si? gʷéru moy h₂ḱméni ksnéwmi. gʷr̥dú kʷim gʷéru ne gʷʰénti. gʷṓs h₂ewsér h₂éǵōmes? h₁íns h₂ewsér h₂éǵōmes. gʷéru toy h₂eḱróm? h₁íd ne h₂eḱróm. h₂éḱmonm̥ moy toy h₁opéye. lm̥bʰdʰí h₁ím h₂éḱih₂m-kʷe gʷr̥dú térye.
english: What are you doing by the fire, friend? I am sharpening my spear on a stone. A dull spear kills no one. Shall we drive off the cattle at dawn? We shall drive them off at dawn. Is your spear sharp? It is not sharp. Give me your stone. Take it, and rub the point slowly.

pie: ǵérh₂ont me ḱHsdʰí. kʷíh₁ gʷéru Hyéh₁koh₂? h₁íd toy deḱsiwóy ǵʰóstoy dʰoréye. h₁énod dóru widéh₁yesi? h₁íd widéh₁yoh₂. dóru spéḱye ǵʰóstom toy mē spéḱyes. nu Hih₁kdʰí. gʷéru moy dóru h₁ért? h₁íd dʰǵʰémi séngʷt. h₂r̥Hmós toy éti ml̥dús. ḱuh₁rós bʰúHeti? yéh₁ni ḱuh₁rós bʰúHeti.
english: Old man, teach me! How shall I throw the spear? Hold it in your right hand. Do you see that tree? I see it. Look at the tree; do not look at your hand. Now throw! Did my spear reach the tree? It fell on the ground. Your arm is still weak. Will it become strong? It will become strong within a year.

pie: kʷís Hrowpóm bʰéh₂geti? wiḱpótis h₁ím dʰh₁tléh₂i bʰéh₂geti. kʷís pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm bʰágt? deywṓs pr̥h₂wóm bʰoh₂góm bʰgént. péh₂wr̥ dh₂pnóy ne dedórḱth₂e? h₁íd dedórḱh₂e. kʷís méǵistom bʰoh₂góm bʰágt? h₁yós dʰérsistos h₁ést só h₁ím bʰágt. dʰérsistos h₁ésesi? h₁ésoh₂-ge.
english: Who divides the booty? The lord divides it in the assembly. Who receives the first share? The gods receive the first share. Have you not seen the fire at the feast? I have seen it. And who receives the largest share? He who was the bravest receives it. Will you be the bravest? I will be.

pie: kʷís wíHre h₂Hséh₂i sédyonts h₂yuHn̥ḱós? dʰǵʰyés gʷémt. ǵʰoysóm gʷʰédʰyeti. polh₁ú mḗms h₂éḱh₃t. h₁yós h₁wésu h₁ḗdti só h₁wésu wikéti. h₁ésmey bʰéh₂s? h₁ésmey bʰā́m. h₁ésyo wékʷesh₂ péh₂ureh₂ h₁ésyo-kʷe h₃ókʷih₁ dʰr̥swíh₁. nu ǵʰoysós h₁ésmey h₁éseti.
english: Husband, who is the young man sitting by the hearth? He came yesterday. He keeps asking for a spear. He has eaten much meat. He who eats well fights well. Did you speak to him? I spoke to him. His words are few, and his eyes are bold. Then he shall have a spear.

pie: kʷíd toy ph₂ter ḱód h₂éh₂usom h₂r̥Hmóy? wiḱpótis moy h₁íd déh₃t. kʷíd tód dʰéh₁t? h₁ésyo ḱérh₂sonm̥ h₂léksom. h₁íd méǵh₂ dóh₃r̥? h₁yós h₂éh₂usom h₁áyto só dʰl̥gʰóm dʰl̥gʰónti. h₂élyōy wiHrṓy h₁íd déh₃esi? h₂élyōy h₁íd ne déh₃oh₂. h₁éy moy priHós. kʷíd moy dʰúgh₂ter dʰédʰh₁ih₁s?
english: Father, what is this gold on your arm? The lord gave it to me. Why did he do that? I protected his head. Is it a great gift? He who takes gold owes a debt. Will you give it to another man? I will not give it to another. He is dear to me. And what would you do, my daughter?

pie: h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: wiHrósyo bʰoh₂góm ḱósyeh₂i nékʷti h₁édoh₂. kʷíd h₁ím h₁édesi? déḱm̥ márkons h₁élh₂m̥ túH-kʷe tríns márkons h₁élh₂s. h₁éysōm h₃rēǵés skéytom sléh₂gʷm̥. kʷóterom méǵyos? wiḱpótis h₃reǵtóm déyḱsih₁t. bʰoh₂góm n̥smé h₁entér bʰéh₂gōmes. bʰéh₂ge h₁ím médʰu-kʷe ǵʰudʰí.
english: Tonight I will eat the hero's portion. Why should you eat it? I drove off ten horses, and you drove off three. But I took the shield of their king. Which of the two is greater? May the lord point out what is right. Let us divide the portion between us. Divide it, and pour the mead.

pie: ph₂ter kóryom ḱósyeh₂i sémeh₂i wédʰōh₂. súHnew moy ne dedwóyth₂e? ne dedwóyh₂e. h₁yós ne ǵn̥h₃rós só swóns wiHróns mórom wédʰeti. nu me ḱHsdʰí. ǵérh₂ontn̥s dʰh₁tléh₂i ḱlowséye. Hrowpóm h₃reǵtóm bʰéh₂ge. pró-kʷe h₁idʰí. gʷéru moy toy déh₃esi? h₁íd toy déh₃oh₂ h₁yód nésēth₂er.
english: Father, let me lead the troop this summer. Are you not afraid, my son? I am not afraid. He who is not wise leads his men to death. Then teach me. Listen to the old men in the assembly. Divide the booty rightly. And go in front. Will you give me your spear? I will give it to you when you come home.

pie: déḱm̥ wetsóns h₁wogʷʰéyes. kʷóti wetsóns h₁idʰé h₁élh₂s? h₁néwn̥ wetsóns h₁élh₂m̥. h₁óynos wetsós déh₂nu h₁n̥dó séngʷt. nu toy h₁éh₁ugʰos h₁sónt ne h₁ést. ne te dʰréwgʰm̥. déh₂nu h₂éti gʷéh₂oh₂? mē gʷéh₂s. tód ne péh₂urom dʰéh₁lom. dh₂pnóy méǵʰye ḱóm sddʰí.
english: You vowed ten calves. How many have you driven here? I drove nine. One calf fell into the river. Then your boast was not true. I did not lie to you. Shall I go back to the river? Do not go. That is no small deed. Sit with me at the feast.

pie: h₃réǵ toy ḱóm márkom h₂éti dédeh₃mi. kʷíd moy déh₃rom spr̥néHsi? h₁ím ne h₂élgʷʰoh₂. kóryoy kʷim ne gʷʰénm̥. péḱu moy péh₂s? h₁íd péh₂sm̥. nu déh₃rom h₂élgʷʰesi. h₁yós bʰéwdʰeti só éti wikéti. déh₃reh₂ moy mē spr̥néHs.
english: King, I give you back this horse. Why do you spurn my gift? I do not deserve it. In the war I struck down no one. Did you guard my livestock? I guarded it. Then you deserve the gift. He who stays awake also fights. Do not spurn my gifts!

pie: Hyúdʰsme moy polh₁ú h₂éh₂usom h₃rēǵéy h₁ésti. likʷdʰí toy wiḱpótim skʷdʰí-kʷe nos. kʷís moy ḱód gʷéru déh₃t? wiḱpótis toy h₁íd déh₃t. kʷís me swéh₂i h₂Hséh₂i h₂életi? h₂életi te. nu h₁ím h₂éh₂usoh₁ ne léykʷoh₂. gʰóstey toy h₃réǵm̥ h₂éti gʷh₂dʰí.
english: Warrior, my king has much gold. Leave your lord and follow us. Who gave me this spear? Your lord gave it. And who feeds me at his hearth? He feeds you. Then I will not leave him for gold. Go back to your king, stranger.

pie: kʷíd moy súHnew wiḱpótih₁ ḱóm h₁éysi? méh₂ter déh₃ōr ḱléwos-kʷe dédeh₃ti. ḱléwos úderom ne pl̥nh₁tés. h₁ésyo-ge moy dh₂pnóm úderom pl̥néh₁ti. ǵʰoysóybʰos ne bʰebʰóyh₂th₂e? h₁éymos-ge bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. h₂egʰṓd h₁némn̥s éti bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. téḱnom wéḱsi h₁yód bʰégʷeti? tód ne wéḱmi. h₁idʰí néseso-kʷe.
english: My son, why do you go with the lord? He gives gifts and fame, mother. Fame does not fill a belly. His feast does fill my belly. Are you not afraid of the spears? I do fear them. But I also fear a bad name. Do you want a child who flees? I do not want one. Go, and return home.

pie: h₃réǵ moy bʰoh₂gós péh₂uros. h₂élyōs péḱu h₂éyos-kʷe bʰgént. kʷíd bʰérdʰs? dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ bʰérdʰm̥. priHós toy déḱm̥ gʷṓs bʰérdʰt. bʰoh₂gós dʰéh₁lom sékʷetor. h₁éḱwons nókʷtm̥ pér péh₂sm̥. tód h₁sónt. nu ḱód h₂éyesos ḱéstrom éti sl̥h₂gʷdʰí. túH h₃reǵtós h₃rḗǵs.
english: King, my share is small. The others received livestock and bronze. What did you capture? I captured two sheep. Your companion captured ten cows. The share follows the deed. But I guarded the horses through the night. That is true. Then take this knife of bronze as well. You are an upright king.

pie: márkom moy dʰl̥gʰési. márkom toy moy péruti déh₃m̥ mért-kʷe. márkom toy dʰl̥gʰóh₂. snóygʷʰoy mért. dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ h₁áyeth₂er? dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ ne márkos. pṓlHom moy wésni dh₃dʰí. nu toy moy HéHḱistom pṓlHom h₁opéyōh₂. nu moy kʷid ne dʰl̥gʰési.
english: You owe me a horse. Last year I gave you my horse, and it died. I owe you a horse. But it died in the snow. Will you take two sheep? Two sheep are not a horse. Give me a foal in the spring. Then I will give you my swiftest foal. Then you owe me nothing.

pie: kúdʰe te ǵʰoysós térh₃t? skélesi me térh₃t. gʷḗn h₁íd mḗdēsi? h₁íd mḗdōh₂. l̥gʰdʰí th₂kéh₁ye-kʷe. h₂ew stéygʰōh₂? méh₁nsi stéygʰēsi. wiḱpótim ḱósyeh₂i sémeh₂i ne sékʷesi. nu moy bʰréh₂tēr gʷéru bʰérēti.
english: Where did the spear wound you? It wounded me in the leg. Will you heal it, woman? I will heal it. Lie down and keep silent. Will I walk again? You will walk within a month. But you will not follow the lord this summer. Then my brother will carry my spear.

pie: h₂éwh₂e wiḱpóteyey h₂éyeri h₃m̥néh₃mi. kʷíh₁ h₁óytom wérh₁oh₂? wékʷesh₂ wóydth₂e? h₁íh₂ ne wóydh₂e. ḱód wr̥h₁dʰí. wíḱpotey te sékʷōh₂er. póyḱōs toy moy póyḱōs. tébʰye ḱóm sth₂éh₁yōh₂. kʷíd wéwkēti? wéwkēti. bʰeydʰós h₁sdʰí sepelyṓh₂-kʷe te.
english: Uncle, in the morning I swear to the lord. How shall I say the oath? Do you know the words? I do not know them. Say this: "Lord, I will follow you. Your enemies are my enemies. I will stand beside you." And what will he say? He will say: "Be faithful, and I will honor you."

pie: h₂éh₂usom moy h₂éti dh₃dʰí h₁yód toy déh₃m̥. wíḱpotey h₁íd h₁áyso. kʷíd h₁íd gʷʰédʰyesi? ne gʰrémes. ḱḗr toy wéydsom. ḱḗr moy te sékʷetor. lm̥bʰdʰí h₂éh₂usom h₂éti ḱód-kʷe péh₃tlom lm̥bʰdʰí. túH h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr.
english: Give me back the gold that I gave you. Take it, lord. Why do you ask for it? You did not become angry. I wanted to see your heart. My heart follows you. Take back the gold, and take this cup. You are a giver of good things.

pie: wíHre méǵh₂ h₁éh₁ugʰos dh₂pnóy mē mléwHs. kʷíd pótni h₁íd ne mléwHoh₂? h₁éh₁ugʰos péruti mléwHs h₁óynom-kʷe káprom ḱóymom h₁élh₂s. wiHrṓs sméyn̥t. h₁éy h₁wésus kápros h₁ést. péh₂urom ḱósmi yéh₁ni mluHdʰí polh₁ú-kʷe péḱu h₁l̥h₂dʰí. ǵn̥h₃róm mléwHsi. h₂ólut moy wérǵesi h₁yód nésōh₂er? h₂ólut wérǵoh₂ h₁yód péḱu ḱóymom h₂éǵēsi.
english: Husband, do not speak a great boast at the feast. Why should I not speak it, wife? Last year you spoke a boast and drove one goat home. The men laughed. It was a good goat. This year speak little and drive much livestock. You speak wisely. Will you make beer for me when I come home? I will make beer if you drive livestock home.
